mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "friend"?
mcq.explanation: صَدِيقٌ (sadiiq) means friend.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ mean?
mcq.explanation: اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ (ismii Ahmad) means: My name is Ahmad.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ (ummii tatbukhu T-taʿaam) means: My mother cooks the food.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence لِي عَيْنَانِ mean?
mcq.explanation: لِي عَيْنَانِ (lii ʿaynaani) means: I have two eyes.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word جِسْمٌ (jism) mean?
mcq.explanation: جِسْمٌ (jism) means body.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ت?
mcq.explanation: The letter ت is called taa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ (ʿindii hadiyya) means: I have a gift.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ (uhibbu l-ʿasiira) means: I like juice.

mcq.q: Which style is old, angular and has straight lines?
mcq.explanation: Kufic is an old angular style used for decoration and old manuscripts.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) mean?
mcq.explanation: السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) means Saturday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خِزَانَةٌ (khizaana) mean?
mcq.explanation: خِزَانَةٌ (khizaana) means cupboard.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "key"?
mcq.explanation: مِفْتَاحٌ (miftaah) means key.

mcq.q: What is a dictation?
options: You copy from the board only
The teacher says a word and you write it
mcq.explanation: In a dictation you listen and write what you hear.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable دُ?
mcq.explanation: دُ is read du.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "goodbye"?
mcq.explanation: مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "Sunday"?
mcq.explanation: الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) means Sunday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ mean?
options: On the table there is a cake.
Above the table there is a balloon.
mcq.explanation: هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ mean?
mcq.explanation: هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ (hal tuhibbu l-mawz?) means: Do you like bananas?

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My body is strong."
mcq.explanation: جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ (jismii qawiyy) means: My body is strong.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ mean?
options: Do you have a party? (to a boy)
May you be well every year.
mcq.explanation: كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ (kulla ʿaamin wa-antum bi-khayr) means: May you be well every year.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ن?
mcq.explanation: The letter ن is called nuun.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "I"?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا (anaa) means I.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "small"?
mcq.explanation: صَغِيرٌ (Sagiir) means small.

mcq.q: Which letter is missing in الجم_ة?
mcq.explanation: The word is الجمعة, al-jumuʿa, Friday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي (aktubu bi-yadii) means: I write with my hand.

mcq.q: What is blending?
options: Joining syllables or sounds together to read a word
mcq.explanation: Blending means saying the sounds one after another and joining them into a word.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable جَ?
mcq.explanation: جَ is read ja.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ mean?
options: I go to school on Monday.
There are seven days in a week.
mcq.explanation: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable تِ?
mcq.explanation: تِ is read ti.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The weather is cold."
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ (al-jawwu baarid) means: The weather is cold.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I visit my grandmother on Friday."
mcq.explanation: أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ (azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa) means: I visit my grandmother on Friday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word قِفْ (qif) mean?
mcq.explanation: قِفْ (qif) means stand up.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "mother"?
mcq.explanation: أُمٌّ (umm) means mother.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَوٌّ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَوٌّ is read jaww and means weather.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) mean?
mcq.explanation: الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) means Sunday.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable لُ?
mcq.explanation: لُ is read lu.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Do not play with the knife."
mcq.explanation: لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ (laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin) means: Do not play with the knife.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Happy birthday."
mcq.explanation: عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ (ʿiid miilaad saʿiid) means: Happy birthday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "drink"?
mcq.explanation: شَرَابٌ (sharaab) means drink.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ mean?
mcq.explanation: نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ (nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a) means: We look after the environment.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word لَا (laa) mean?
mcq.explanation: لَا (laa) means no.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word قَدَمٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: قَدَمٌ is read qadam and means foot.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ج make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ج makes the sound j as in jug.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَطَرٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَطَرٌ is read matar and means rain.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "party"?
mcq.explanation: حَفْلَةٌ (hafla) means party.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَرْحَبًا read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَرْحَبًا is read marhaban and means hello.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word نَعَمْ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: نَعَمْ is read naʿam and means yes.

mcq.q: Which word means 'sun'?
mcq.explanation: shams means sun.

mcq.q: What is the ending of the letter ة in جَدَّةٌ called?
mcq.explanation: ة is taa marbuta and appears at the end of many feminine words.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) mean?
mcq.explanation: طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) means tomatoes.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ادْخُلْ (udkhul) mean?
mcq.explanation: ادْخُلْ (udkhul) means come in.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ز?
mcq.explanation: The letter ز is called zaay.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable ثَا?
mcq.explanation: ثَا is read thaa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا مِنْ كينيا mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا مِنْ كينيا (anaa min Kiiniya) means: I am from Kenya.

mcq.q: Which question do you ask when you point to a boy and want to know who he is?
mcq.explanation: haadhaa means 'this' for a boy or man. haadhihi is used for a girl or woman.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is my house."
mcq.explanation: هَذَا بَيْتِي (haadhaa baytii) means: This is my house.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word رَقَبَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: رَقَبَةٌ is read raqaba and means neck.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "beside"?
mcq.explanation: بِجَانِبِ (bijaanibi) means beside.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word غَائِمٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: غَائِمٌ is read ghaa'im and means cloudy.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word سُكَّرٌ (sukkar) mean?
mcq.explanation: سُكَّرٌ (sukkar) means sugar.

mcq.q: Which sentence says 'I clean my teeth'?
mcq.explanation: unadhdhifu means I clean and asnaanii means my teeth.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) means hello.

mcq.q: What is the special sign hamza (ء)?
options: A short stop in the throat
mcq.explanation: The hamza is a short pause made in the throat, like the stop in 'uh-oh'.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'On the table there is a cake'?
mcq.explanation: ʿalaa means on, taawila is table and kaʿka is cake.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "day"?
mcq.explanation: يَوْمٌ (yawm) means day.

mcq.q: Which is the correct spelling of Thursday?
mcq.explanation: Thursday begins with khaa (خ), which has one dot above.

mcq.q: Which day ends with taa marbuta (ة)?
mcq.explanation: الجمعة ends with ة.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "We look after the environment."
mcq.explanation: نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ (nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a) means: We look after the environment.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word سَمَاءٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: سَمَاءٌ is read samaa' and means sky.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ش make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ش makes the sound sh as in shop.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ mean?
options: The key is in the cupboard.
Do not play with the knife.
The chair is at the door.
mcq.explanation: لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ (laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin) means: Do not play with the knife.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "Monday"?
mcq.explanation: الِاثْنَيْنِ (al-ithnayn) means Monday.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أُغْنِيَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أُغْنِيَةٌ is read ughniya and means song.

mcq.q: How many syllables are in the word kataba (ka-ta-ba)?
mcq.explanation: ka + ta + ba makes three syllables.

mcq.q: Which word means 'above'?
mcq.explanation: fawqa means above. taHta means under, fii means in and ʿalaa means on.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ش?
mcq.explanation: The letter ش is called shiin.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَطْنٌ (batn) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَطْنٌ (batn) means stomach.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ذ?
mcq.explanation: The letter ذ is called dhaal.

mcq.q: What does the phrase al-hamdu lillaah express?
mcq.explanation: al-hamdu lillaah means 'thanks be to God' and is often said when answering 'How are you?'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "behind"?
mcq.explanation: خَلْفَ (khalfa) means behind.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ط?
mcq.explanation: The letter ط is called Taa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ mean?
options: Above the table there is a balloon.
On the table there is a cake.
The friends are at the party.
mcq.explanation: فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ (fawqa t-taawilati baaluun) means: Above the table there is a balloon.

mcq.q: Which word do you add to an instruction to make it polite?
mcq.explanation: min fadlika means 'please'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "A gift for Amina."
mcq.explanation: هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter د make?
mcq.explanation: The letter د makes the sound d as in dog.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَارِدٌ (baarid) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَارِدٌ (baarid) means cold.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable لِ?
mcq.explanation: لِ is read li.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ (anaa uhibbu l-hafla) means: I like the party.

mcq.q: Which letter completes the word _ُور to make nuur (light)?
mcq.explanation: The word nuur (نُور) starts with nuun.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ mean?
options: On the table there is a cake.
The friends are at the party.
Above the table there is a balloon.
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ (haadhihi hafla) means: This is a party.

mcq.q: What does the ending -aani show in yadaani?
mcq.explanation: The dual ending -aani means two, so yadaani is two hands.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ (irfaʿ yadaka) mean?
mcq.explanation: ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ (irfaʿ yadaka) means raise your hand.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ mean?
mcq.explanation: جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ (jismii qawiyy) means: My body is strong.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ (ash-shamsu haarra) means: The sun is hot.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word فَمٌ (fam) mean?
mcq.explanation: فَمٌ (fam) means mouth.

mcq.q: How is the syllable بُ read?
mcq.explanation: The mark Damma gives the vowel u, so بُ is bu.

mcq.q: What does the small word min mean in anaa min Kiiniya?
mcq.explanation: min means 'from', so the sentence says 'I am from Kenya'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word لِسَانٌ (lisaan) mean?
mcq.explanation: لِسَانٌ (lisaan) means tongue.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ر make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ر makes the sound a quick rolled r.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَخِي يَلْعَبُ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: أَخِي يَلْعَبُ (akhii yalʿabu) means: My brother plays.
